# terrakube_project_access (Resource)

Manage project access. Grants a team RBAC permissions scoped to a project (and therefore to every workspace within it).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "terrakube_project_access" "project_access" {
  name            = "my_terrakube_team"
  organization_id = "my_organization_id"
  project_id      = "my_project_id"

  manage_job       = true # legacy field — plan_job/approve_job inherit from this when unset
  manage_state     = false
  manage_workspace = false
  plan_job         = true     # RBAC v2: required for "New Run" button
  approve_job      = true     # RBAC v2: required for apply approval
  destroy_job      = false    # Terrakube 2.34.0+: deny destroy runs for this custom role
  role             = "custom" # "custom" defers to boolean flags
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name
- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization id
- `project_id` (String) Terrakube project id

### Optional

- `approve_job` (Boolean) Allow approving/applying runs (RBAC v2). Inherits manage_job when not set. Only used when role is unset or "custom". Note: inheritance only applies on create/update — imported resources retain the remote value.
- `destroy_job` (Boolean) Allow destroy runs when role is custom or unset (Terrakube 2.34.0+). This is an additional gate alongside plan/apply permissions. When unset, preserves the server value (true on creation); omitted for older APIs.
- `manage_job` (Boolean) Allow to manage and trigger jobs. Legacy field — in RBAC v2, plan_job/approve_job inherit from this when unset.
- `manage_state` (Boolean) Allow to manage Terraform/OpenTofu state
- `manage_workspace` (Boolean) Allow to create, update, and delete workspaces within the project
- `plan_job` (Boolean) Allow queuing plans (RBAC v2). Inherits manage_job when not set. Only used when role is unset or "custom". Note: inheritance only applies on create/update — imported resources retain the remote value.
- `role` (String) Predefined role: admin (all permissions), write (plan+apply+workspace+state), plan (plan only), read (read only), or custom (use boolean flags). When set to a non-custom value, overrides individual boolean flags. Leave unset to use boolean flags.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Access Id

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Project access can be imported with organization_id,project_id,id
terraform import terrakube_project_access.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
